purpose: Save one asserted SpaceClaim document to a new run-owned native path without reopening it.
trigger: Use only after the current root Part and every supplied critical check match the accepted run.

inputs.name: expected_root
inputs.description: Expected current root Part identity and binding.

inputs.name: run_root
inputs.description: Absolute run-owned directory; not a baseline, evidence, or existing-output ancestor.

inputs.name: output_path
inputs.description: New .scdoc path under run_root; it must not already exist.

inputs.name: critical_checks
inputs.description: Checks with id and status; every critical check must be passed.

preconditions: Active document is expected current root Part and all critical checks passed.
run_root is absolute/run-owned and output_path is a new .scdoc beneath it.
No native save has occurred for output_path.

outputs.name: sha256
outputs.description: SHA-256 of the saved native-model bytes.

outputs.name: native_save
outputs.description: passed only after native save and hash succeed.

outputs.name: native_reopen
outputs.description: Always not_tested for this save-only operation.

postconditions: Formal artifact returns path, SHA-256, native_save=passed, native_reopen=not_tested after one new native output.
Existing path, failed check, root mismatch, unsafe ancestor, or save error is rejected.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21 / IronPython 2.7 .scscript execution in an authorized session.
implementation.notes: Invoke the formal .scscript with ATOMIC_INPUT={expected_root,run_root,output_path,critical_checks}; ATOMIC_OUTPUT={path,sha256,native_save,native_reopen}. expected_root is a live Part identity, not serialized JSON. New-output only, save-only; raises ValueError for rejected input and RuntimeError for failed post-save assertions. Native save and reopen evidence remain independent.

ambiguity_checks: Use only the declared identity, state, or geometry predicates; do not substitute recorded FaceN/BodyN aliases or an arbitrary collection member.
If the declared evidence cannot make the target unique, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; the operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: Root, path/newness, or critical checks fail.
failure_modes.detection: Formal artifact rejects expected_root, run_root/output_path, or a check.
failure_modes.safe_state: No native success output is promoted.

failure_modes.condition: Save command or post-save hash fails.
failure_modes.detection: Artifact returns error or hash cannot be read.
failure_modes.safe_state: Preserve error; do not claim native_save=passed.

recovery.action: Correct the failed precondition and rerun from clean asserted state; do not overwrite.
Keep failed output run-owned and diagnose with ER-10.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare operation_id with the EX/ER catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, remains candidate, and declares exactly one bounded execution_recovery action.

validation.method: Read the linked single-operation guidance and compare its input, result, procedure, and rejection fields with this contract.
validation.expected: The contract exposes every declared input/output and preserves refusal, recovery, and needs_manual_review behavior.

validation.method: Use the operation-specific controller or host-tool adapter only after the required authorization and target-state gates are independently satisfied.
validation.expected: Formal artifact returns path, SHA-256, native_save=passed, native_reopen=not_tested after one new native output.

evidence_level.notes: Five host input guards and exact V21 save-01 critical-save-block/native-save checks passed. Save-only new-output variant; reopen and complete visual review not performed.
